title: (RHBA-2020:3428) Update to Fuse 7.7.0 images
portal_summary: Updated fuse7/fuse-eap-openshift container image is now available for RHEL-7 based Middleware Containers.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.10|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.11|x86_64
portal_solution:
The RHEL-7 based Middleware Containers container images provided by this update can be downloaded from the Red Hat Container Registry at registry.access.redhat.com. Installation instructions for your platform are available at Red Hat Container Catalog (see References).

Dockerfiles and scripts should be amended either to refer to this new image specifically, or to the latest image generally.
portal_description:
The Fuse 7.7 container images have been updated for RHEL-7 based Middleware Containers to address the following security advisories:  RHSA-2020:2968 and RHBA-2020:57062 (see References)

Users of Fuse 7.7 container images are advised to upgrade to these updated images, which contain backported patches to correct these security issues, fix these bugs and add these enhancements. Users of these images are also encouraged to rebuild all container images that depend on these images.

You can find images updated by this advisory in Red Hat Container Catalog (see References).
